input.title: A Light in the Attic
input.description: It's hard to imagine a world without A Light in the Attic. This now-classic collection of poetry and drawings from Shel Silverstein celebrates its 20th anniversary with this special edition.

input.title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
input.description: From a renowned historian comes a groundbreaking narrative of humanity's creation and evolution, a #1 international bestseller that explores the ways in which biology and history have defined us.

input.title: Sharp Objects
input.description: Fresh from a brief stay at a psych hospital, reporter Camille Preaker's first assignment brings her reluctantly back to her hometown to cover the murders of two preteen girls.

input.title: Shakespeare's Sonnets
input.description: This book is an important and complete collection of the Sonnets of William Shakespeare, written around the same period as his great plays.

input.title: Aladdin and His Wonderful Lamp
input.description: Read the classic story of Aladdin and his Wonderful Lamp in this sparkling new edition. Aladdin is a poor boy who lives with his mother in the ancient kingdom of Cathay.

input.title: Maude (1883-1993): She Grew Up with the Country
input.description: This is the true story of Maude, updated by the author's daughters with historical details, photos, and appendices. During her 110-year lifetime, Maude went from a wood-burning stove to a microwave oven.
